name: NST Simple Swap
fix_description: In buyNST (0x6e41592c) and sellNST (0x7cd0599b), the contract calls token.approve(msg.sender, amount) which gives the user allowance over the contract holdings. This is backwards — the contract should use transferFrom to pull tokens from the user, not approve its own tokens to the user. Remove the erroneous approve calls.
difficulty_reasoning: The PoC is extremely short and effectively a two-step exploit against a single swap contract: buy NST, sell it back via raw selector calls, then directly drain USDT with transferFrom. It requires little protocol-specific DeFi knowledge, no complex routing or state reasoning, and matches an obvious broken-access-control/approval logic pattern.
